title: Campaign brief
description: Plan a marketing campaign with its audience, message, channels, measures and approvals before any tool sends or publishes.

inputs.label: Business objective and the decision it supports
Audience segment, described without personal data
Product or feature and the claim the campaign makes

tool_actions.description: Sending emails or messages to contacts through the campaign tool.
Publishing ads, posts or landing pages.

sections.title: Message
sections.prompt: The promise, the proof behind it and the call to action, in the words the audience uses.

sections.title: Channels and calendar
sections.prompt: Each channel, why it reaches the audience, and the dates.

sections.title: Measurement
sections.prompt: The metric that shows success, its baseline, the target and how links are tagged.

sections.title: Consent and data
sections.prompt: Which contact lists are used, on which legal basis, and how people opt out.

checks.verification: Each claim in the message points to evidence the team can show.
The contact lists and their legal basis are confirmed by the data protection owner.
Tracking links and the success metric are set up before launch.

sources.title: UK Government Functional Standard GovS 011, Communication, the campaign lifecycle
CNIL, Site web, cookies et autres traceurs
